title: Patch: the card pictures' scene kits and recipes load alongside the engine module, not in the first page load
thread:
**Issue #4222 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4222: Patch: the card pictures' scene kits and recipes load alongside the engine module, not in the first page load
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The browser draws every card picture itself, from a large set of drawing parts and one recipe per card. Today all of that downloads before the first screen appears. It isn't needed that early: no card can be shown until the game engine has arrived, and the engine only starts downloading after the first screen's code has run. Once this is built, the first page is smaller and appears sooner. The engine also starts downloading sooner, and the pictures arrive alongside it, so cards look exactly as they do now and show up no later. A visitor on a phone or a slow connection sees the landing page sooner. Nobody sees a card drawn differently.

## Why

- **How the data gets into the first load:** `main.tsx:102` imports `routes/landing.tsx` statically. The landing imports `cards/CardFace.tsx` (`:119`), which reaches `cards/art/index.ts`, then `CardArt.tsx:63`, then `svg.ts:25` and `procedural.ts:10`, then `scene.ts:20-22`. `scene.ts` statically imports `sceneKit.ts`, `figureKit.ts` and `sceneRecipes.ts`: every scene kit and about 1,019 card recipes.
- **How big it is:** 3,216,076 bytes of source. `sceneKit.ts` alone is 369,180 bytes and `figureKit.ts` 254,733; the recipe files total 1,696,416. With line comments stripped and gzipped, that is about 653 KB. Minified it is smaller, but it is still the largest single block of data in the first load. `net/first-load.test.ts:29-34` records that 48 recipes added 7,266 gzipped bytes, about 150 bytes each, so the recipes alone come to roughly 150 KB before the kits. After #4130 the whole first load measured 980,254 gzipped bytes; `FIRST_LOAD_GZIP_BUDGET_BYTES` is 999,424 (`first-load.test.ts:47`).
- **No first-load screen can use it before the engine arrives:** a card face is the engine module's face model (`wasm/useEngineReady.ts:1-4`). The landing's card fan and the not-found page's card wait on `useEngineReady()` (`landing.tsx:608`), and every other screen waits behind `EngineGate`. The module is fetched only after the entry script has run (`main.tsx:953`), so a heavier entry also delays the engine.
- **The seam is clean:** the scene data is read through four names only, `SCENE_RECIPES` and `ALT_SCENE_RECIPES` (both in `sceneRecipeOf`, `scene.ts:251`), `SCENE_KIT` and `drawFigure`. `scene.ts` has three importers (`svg.ts`, `procedural.ts`, `dioramas/pieces.ts`), and all of them go through `sceneRecipeOf`, `withScene` or `composeScene`.
- **Precedent:** this is the same kind of cut as #4130 (the sound tables, 101,386 gzipped bytes less) and #4180 (the catalog copy, PR #4215), and it touches neither.

## Proposal

1. Add a small loader beside `scene.ts`. It dynamically imports one data module that re-exports the kits, the figure kit and both recipe tables, then installs them into `scene.ts`. `scene.ts` keeps its API, its types and its small constants (`SCENE_BOX`, the layers, the palette), and reads the four tables from the installed slot.
2. The page starts this load next to `loadWasm()` in `main.tsx`. Anything that waits for the engine before drawing a face resolves only once both are in: `useEngineReady`, `WhenEngineReady`, `EngineGate`, and `routes/chunks.tsx`'s prefetch on intent. The practice worker imports `wasm/index.ts` but draws no pictures, so the scene wait belongs in the page's callers, not inside `loadWasm()`.
3. Before install, `sceneRecipeOf` throws a clear error instead of answering null, the way `wasm/index.ts`'s `call` does before load. A null answer would draw the plain painter's picture and cache it in `svg.ts`'s `proceduralCache`. With the error, a face drawn too early fails a test instead of shipping the wrong picture.
4. `test/setup.ts` installs the tables synchronously, as it already loads the wasm synchronously, so every existing art test runs unchanged.
5. Measure the first load as CI builds it (`vite build --mode development`) and lower `FIRST_LOAD_GZIP_BUDGET_BYTES` to that number plus its usual 2% or so of headroom, writing the measurement in its comment.

## Where it lands

- `apps/web/src/cards/art/scene.ts`, plus a new loader and data module beside it
- `apps/web/src/main.tsx`, `apps/web/src/wasm/useEngineReady.ts`, `apps/web/src/wasm/WhenEngineReady.tsx`, and the engine gate (`main.tsx`, `routes/chunks.tsx`)
- `apps/web/src/test/setup.ts`
- `apps/web/src/net/first-load.test.ts`
- `apps/web/README.md` (The engine as WebAssembly) and `apps/web/src/cards/art/ART.md` (Scene recipes and kits)
- No SPEC change and no ruling: presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7). Nothing in the engine, the view or replays changes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A source test, modelled on the `#4130` static-import test, fails if any non-test module other than the loader's data module statically imports `sceneKit*.ts`, `figureKit.ts` or a recipe file.
- [ ] The built-file block of `first-load.test.ts` checks that strings found only in the kits and recipes are absent from the entry chunk and its modulepreloads.
- [ ] A test shows `useEngineReady()` stays false while the module is in but the scene tables are not, and turns true once both are.
- [ ] A test shows `sceneRecipeOf` throws before install, rather than returning null for a card that has a recipe.
- [ ] Every existing art test (`cards/art/*.test.ts*`, `artRichness.test.ts`, the Scenes suites) passes unchanged.
- [ ] `FIRST_LOAD_GZIP_BUDGET_BYTES` is lowered to the measured build plus headroom, with the measurement in its comment.
- [ ] The practice worker's bundle holds no scene data.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, eslint and the touched test files are green.

## Size and risks

Medium: about 8 to 10 files, no Rust, no ruling.

- **A picture drawn before the gate,** for example by a pile dialog or the full-screen art host mounting before the engine: the throwing `sceneRecipeOf` turns that into a failing test instead of a wrong picture.
- **A slow network:** the first cards could wait briefly for the art chunk. That chunk is much smaller than the 2.31 MB engine module that loads in parallel with it.
- **Overlap:** it builds on #4180 / PR #4215 and does not conflict with it.

---

Area: `client` (`suggestions.areas`).

Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it.

# Plan for #4222: load the card pictures' scene kits and recipes alongside the engine module

## 1. Goal

Move the scene data (`sceneKit*.ts`, `figureKit.ts`, every `*Recipes*.ts`) out of the first load into a lazily imported chunk that starts next to `loadWasm()`. `scene.ts` keeps its API, types, and small constants and reads the four tables (`SCENE_KIT`, `drawFigure`, `SCENE_RECIPES`, `ALT_SCENE_RECIPES`) from an installed slot; `sceneRecipeOf` throws before install so an early face fails a test instead of caching the painter's picture. `FIRST_LOAD_GZIP_BUDGET_BYTES` is lowered to the measured build plus ~2% headroom. No SPEC change, no ruling: presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7).

## 2. Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/cards/art/sceneData.ts` | new | Re-exports `SCENE_KIT`, `drawFigure`, `SCENE_RECIPES`, `ALT_SCENE_RECIPES` |
| `apps/web/src/cards/art/sceneLoader.ts` | new | `loadSceneData()`, `sceneDataReady()`, `resetSceneDataForTests()`, `deferSceneDataForTests()` |
| `apps/web/src/cards/art/scene.ts` | change | Installed slot; `installSceneData`, `SceneTables`, throwing `sceneRecipeOf`/`composeScene`; `SCENE_BOX` from `kitDraw.ts` |
| `apps/web/src/main.tsx` | change | Boot `loadSceneData()`; `EngineGate` waits for both loads |
| `apps/web/src/wasm/useEngineReady.ts` | change | Ready only when module and scene tables are both in |
| `apps/web/src/wasm/WhenEngineReady.tsx` | change | Header comment names the scene tables |
| `apps/web/src/routes/chunks.tsx` | change | `prefetchRoute`/`startScreen` start `loadSceneData()` for engine routes |
| `apps/web/src/test/setup.ts` | change | Synchronous install of the tables |
| `apps/web/src/cards/art/scene.test.ts` | change | Append `#4222` throws-before-install test |
| `apps/web/src/wasm/WhenEngineReady.test.tsx` | change | Append `#4222` gating test |
| `apps/web/src/net/first-load.test.ts` | change | Source import test, built-file probe tests, worker test, lowered budget |
| `apps/web/src/cards/art/ART.md` | change | "Scene recipes and kits": lazy-loading paragraph |
| `apps/web/README.md` | change | "The engine as WebAssembly": scene chunk alongside the module |

Never touch: `crates/*`, `spec/*` (no ruling note, no `§11` paragraph), `apps/edge`, `apps/admin`, `e2e`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `practice.worker.ts`, `wasm/index.ts` (the scene wait belongs in the page's callers, not inside `loadWasm()`). No spec section governs this change.

## 3. Steps

1. **`scene.ts`: cut the data imports.** Replace the value imports of `./figureKit.ts` (line 18), `./sceneKit.ts` (line 21), `./sceneRecipes.ts` (line 22) with `import type` of the same names (`drawFigure`, `SCENE_KIT`, `SCENE_RECIPES`, `ALT_SCENE_RECIPES` become types via `typeof`; keep `FigureLook`, `PoseId`, `FigurePartId`, `SceneryPartId` as type imports). Change line 27 to `export { SCENE_BOX } from "./kitDraw.ts";` (defined there as `100`; `kitDraw.ts` value-imports only `hash.ts`, its `scene.ts` import is type-only). Value imports left: `hash.ts`, `kitDraw.ts`, `themes.ts`.
2. **`scene.ts`: add the slot.** Add `export type SceneTables = { readonly SCENE_KIT: typeof SCENE_KIT; readonly SCENE_RECIPES: typeof SCENE_RECIPES; readonly ALT_SCENE_RECIPES: typeof ALT_SCENE_RECIPES; readonly drawFigure: typeof drawFigure };`, `let installed: SceneTables | null = null;`, `export function installSceneData(tables: SceneTables): void`, `export function sceneDataReady(): boolean`, and an internal accessor that throws `` `the scene tables are not loaded: await loadSceneData() before calling ${name}` `` (mirror `wasm/index.ts`'s `call`). `sceneRecipeOf` reads the tables through it (missing card still returns null); `composeScene` reads `SCENE_KIT`/`drawFigure` through it. `withScene` is unchanged.
3. **New `sceneData.ts`.** Re-export only: `export { SCENE_KIT } from "./sceneKit.ts";`, `export { drawFigure } from "./figureKit.ts";`, `export { ALT_SCENE_RECIPES, SCENE_RECIPES } from "./sceneRecipes.ts";`. This is the one data module the source test allowlists.
4. **New `sceneLoader.ts`, modelled on `audio/soundTablesLoader.ts`.** `loadSceneData(): Promise<void>` is idempotent, does `await import("./sceneData.ts")` then `installSceneData(...)`, clears `pendingLoad` on failure so the next call retries. `sceneDataReady()` reports the slot. `resetSceneDataForTests()` clears slot and pending. `deferSceneDataForTests()` mirrors `deferSoundTablesForTests` (returns `{ resolve(), reject(err) }` driving the pending promise) for the gating test.
5. **`test/setup.ts`: install synchronously.** After `loadWasmSync(...)`, statically import the four names from their data files and call `installSceneData({ SCENE_KIT, drawFigure, SCENE_RECIPES, ALT_SCENE_RECIPES })`. Allowed: `sources()` in `first-load.test.ts` skips the `test/` directory.
6. **`main.tsx`: start and gate.** Import `loadSceneData` from `./cards/art/sceneLoader.ts`; next to line 961 add `void loadSceneData().catch(() => undefined);`. In `EngineGate`, replace the `loadWasm()`-only wait with `void Promise.all([loadWasm(), loadSceneData()]).then(() => { if (live) setLoad("ready"); }, (cause) => { if (!live) return; console.error(...); setLoad("failed"); })`, keeping `loadCardTables()` best-effort. A scene-chunk failure fails closed to the existing retry panel (a painter fallback would cache the wrong picture). Update the `#778`/`#4180` comments to name `#4222` and the scene tables.
7. **`useEngineReady.ts`: gate on both.** Initial state `wasmLoaded() && sceneDataReady()`; effect awaits `Promise.all([loadWasm(), loadSceneData()])` before `setReady(true)`, failures ignored as today. Keep the best-effort `loadCardTables()` block. Update the header comment (`#4222`: readiness is module plus scene tables).
8. **`WhenEngineReady.tsx`, `NotFoundPlay.tsx`, `landing.tsx`: no logic change** (they delegate to `useEngineReady`). Only update `WhenEngineReady.tsx`'s header comment to say the face waits for the module and the scene tables.
9. **`routes/chunks.tsx`: prefetch and start.** Import `loadSceneData`; in `prefetchRoute`'s `ENGINE_CHUNKS` branch and in `startScreen`'s `engine` branch add `void loadSceneData().catch(() => undefined);` beside the `loadSoundTables()` call, with a `#4222` comment.
10. **Docs.** `ART.md` "Scene recipes and kits": append that the kits and both recipe tables reach the client in a chunk `loadSceneData()` fetches beside the engine module, installed into `scene.ts`; before install `sceneRecipeOf` throws. `README.md` "The engine as WebAssembly": in the `src/wasm/index.ts` bullet, note the scene chunk loads beside the module and `EngineGate`/`useEngineReady` wait for both; in the `chunks.tsx` bullet, note engine routes also start `loadSceneData()`.
11. **Measure and lower the budget last.** Run `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`, then `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vite build --mode development` (the exact CI `web-build` command), compute the entry-plus-preloads gzipped bytes with the test's own math, set the budget to the smallest `N × 8192 ≥ measured × 1.02`, and extend the comment history with a `#4222` paragraph in the existing style (what left the first load, measured bytes, headroom, what would cross it).

## 4. Tests

- `apps/web/src/cards/art/scene.test.ts`, new `it("#4222 sceneRecipeOf throws before the tables are installed")`: `resetSceneDataForTests()` then `expect(() => sceneRecipeOf("core-002")).toThrow("the scene tables are not loaded")` (`core-002` has a recipe, so null would be wrong); `afterEach` restores with `await loadSceneData()` so the file's other tests keep setup's install.
- `apps/web/src/wasm/WhenEngineReady.test.tsx`, new `it("#4222 useEngineReady stays false until the scene tables arrive")`: assert `wasmLoaded()` is true, `deferSceneDataForTests()`, render the file's `Probe`, flush a macrotask and expect `"waiting"`, resolve the deferred load, `await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText("ready"))...)`; `afterEach` restores with `await loadSceneData()`.
- `apps/web/src/net/first-load.test.ts`, new `it("#4222 no non-test module statically imports scene data")`: scan `sources(SRC)` as `#4130` does; strip `import type` lines (they emit no bytes); offenders are files whose remaining text matches `sceneKit*.ts`, `figureKit.ts`, or `*Recipes*.ts` targets and that are not themselves data files (`cards/art/` basename starts with `sceneKit`, is `figureKit.ts`, contains `Recipes`) nor `sceneData.ts`; assert offenders empty and the exempt set contains `sceneKit.ts`, `figureKit.ts`, `sceneRecipes.ts`.
- Same file, new `it("#4222 the entry chunk and its preloads hold no scene kit or recipe text")`: reuse `entryAndPreloads()`; probes `"bone-scarecrow"`, `"pose-genuflect"`, `"item-trunk-club"` (each verified to occur in `src` only in data files, tests, or `ART.md`); assert absent from every file.
- Same file, new `it("#4222 the practice worker's bundle holds no scene data")`: find the built asset containing `"the practice engine could not be loaded"` (unique to `practice.worker.ts`), assert it exists and holds none of the three probes.
- Existing suites run unchanged: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/cards/art/scene.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/wasm/WhenEngineReady.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/cards/art/artRichness.test.ts`, one Scenes suite (e.g. `src/cards/art/coreScenes.test.ts`), then `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/first-load.test.ts` (with `dist/` built), `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, eslint on the touched files, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## 5. Done when

- [ ] Source test fails on any non-allowlisted static import of kit/recipe files.
- [ ] Entry chunk plus modulepreloads hold none of the three probes; worker bundle holds none.
- [ ] `useEngineReady()` is false with module in and tables out, true with both; `sceneRecipeOf` throws before install.
- [ ] Every existing art test, `artRichness.test.ts`, and the Scenes suites pass unchanged.
- [ ] Budget lowered to measured × 1.02 rounded up to 8192, with the measurement in its comment.
- [ ] `typecheck`, eslint, the touched test files, and `cargo jackioh spec check` are green.

## 6. Risks

- A face drawn before the gate (pile dialog, full-screen host) now throws instead of drawing the painter's picture; that is the point (wrong pictures must fail tests, never ship), and every gate waits for both loads first.
- `import type` must stay `import type`: converting one to a value import rejoins the chunk and fails the source test.
- Probes must be runtime string literals; if one turns out to occur outside the data files, pick another data-only literal rather than weakening the test.
- The reset in `scene.test.ts` / `WhenEngineReady.test.tsx` must restore via `loadSceneData()` in `afterEach`, or later tests in the same file run uninstalled.
- Local `vite build --mode development` numbers may differ slightly from CI's; the 2% headroom covers it.

## 7. Open questions

None.

Change line 27 to `export { SCENE_BOX } from "./kitDraw.ts";` (defined there as `100`; `kitDraw.ts` value-imports only `hash.ts`, its `scene.ts` import is type-only). Value imports left: `hash.ts`, `kitDraw.ts`, `themes.ts`.
2. **`scene.ts`: add the slot.** Add `export type SceneTables = { readonly SCENE_KIT: typeof SCENE_KIT; readonly SCENE_RECIPES: typeof SCENE_RECIPES; readonly ALT_SCENE_RECIPES: typeof ALT_SCENE_RECIPES; readonly drawFigure: typeof drawFigure };`, `let installed: SceneTables | null = null;`, `export function installSceneData(tables: SceneTables): void`, `export function sceneDataReady(): boolean`, and an internal accessor that throws `` `the scene tables are not loaded: await loadSceneData() before calling ${name}` `` (mirror `wasm/index.ts`'s `call`). `sceneRecipeOf` reads the tables through it (missing card still returns null); `composeScene` reads `SCENE_KIT`/`drawFigure` through it. `withScene` is unchanged.

A scene-chunk failure fails closed to the existing retry panel (a painter fallback would cache the wrong picture). Update the `#778`/`#4180` comments to name `#4222` and the scene tables.

Keep the best-effort `loadCardTables()` block. Update the header comment (`#4222`: readiness is module plus scene tables).
